findings.text: GPU sharing on: up to 8 pods per Intel GPU, balanced allocation (K3D_GPU_INTEL_SHARED=auto); pods share its memory and engines with no isolation
CPU ISA: AVXVNNI CETIBT GFNI SHA VAES — up labels nodes feature.node.kubernetes.io/cpu-cpuid.<name>=true (NFD names)

RDT allocation (rdt_a: cat_l2 cdp_l2) — resctrl classes are available but left off: the balloons policy ships control.rdt.enable: false because enabling it rewrites the host's /sys/fs/resctrl. To opt in, mount resctrl on the host (mount -t resctrl resctrl /sys/fs/resctrl) and set control.rdt.enable: true in nri-balloons.yml; usePodQoSAsDefaultClass then gives BestEffort/Burstable/Guaranteed pods 33%/66%/100% of the L3. To revert, set control.rdt.enable: false in nri-balloons.yml, then sudo umount /sys/fs/resctrl

noisy-neighbour isolation: rdt-cat — CAT can cap a neighbour's cache share through the RDT opt-in above (resctrl mounted: no); no MBA, so DRAM bandwidth stays shared; the classes run inside the NRI balloons policy, which up deploys on hybrid or multi-NUMA hosts only

the CPU has VT-x (vmx) but /dev/kvm is missing: no microVM sandboxes
findings.why: kvm_intel creates /dev/kvm; without it Kata or Firecracker cannot start a VM

findings.apply: BIOS: enable VT-d, then add intel_iommu=on to the kernel command line and reboot
findings.revert: remove intel_iommu=on from the kernel command line and reboot
findings.text: no IOMMU unit registered: no DMA isolation between devices, no GPU passthrough into a microVM
findings.why: VFIO hands a device to a VM only with its IOMMU group; without VT-d enabled there are no groups

sections.good: cores ramp to full turbo the moment a request arrives: EPP performance or balance_performance, turbo on, no frequency caps — token generation is a latency-bound loop and every ramp-up shows in time-to-first-token
sections.name: CPU frequency (driver none)
